answer.summary: JE-US01-2609-00956 duplicates JE-US01-2609-00955. Both entries accrue the same September 2026 work: $64,000.00 for Hartwell & Pryce LLP on matter M-2207 contract review, with the same Dr 6610/CC5100 and Cr 2150/CC7150 lines. The manual entry was posted on 2026-10-02 and the spreadsheet upload on 2026-10-03, by different preparers and approvers. Neither entry has a reference number, and nothing in the descriptions points to a second, separate piece of work. Approve the proposed OCT-26 reversal of 00956 (Dr 2150/CC7150, Cr 6610/CC5100 $64,000), which keeps 00955.

evidence.text: JE-00956 (Spreadsheet upload batch, created 2026-10-03 11:06 by E35126, approved by E30233): Dr 6610/CC5100 $64,000, Cr 2150/CC7150 $64,000, Sep-26 accrual Hartwell & Pryce M-2207 contract review, no reference.
JE-00955 (Manual batch, created 2026-10-02 10:12 by E35123, approved by E35051): same accounts, cost centres, $64,000 and description, no reference.

Matter M-2207 (supplier contract review) has a life-of-matter budget of $893,000 and $645,353.75 billed to date. Adding $64,000 brings it to 79.4%. The budget check does not show whether one or two accruals were expected.
